bot.name: Clankwarden
bot.description: Scammer/bot account containment (.clank) with smart, server-aware dehoisting, plus a full moderation and audit-logging suite, rendered in Discord Components V2.
bot.author: HiLleywyn

fields.label: Discord application (client) ID
fields.help: Required. From the Discord developer portal OAuth2 page; powers the Invite button.

fields.label: Clanker role
fields.help: Containment role applied to clanked users.

fields.label: Clanker category
fields.help: Category the containment channels live under.

fields.label: Escape-room thread
fields.help: Shared thread where escape-room cases are posted.

fields.label: Reflection period (minutes)
fields.help: Mandatory reflection wait before an escape unlocks.

fields.label: Clanker hunter role
fields.help: Members of this role can report scammers in the hunter channel.

fields.label: Clanker hunter channel
fields.help: Channel where hunters post reports that auto-clank flagged users.

fields.label: Mod log channel
fields.help: Comprehensive moderation log for every tracked event.

fields.label: Command replies (seconds)
fields.help: Self-delete command/mod-command reply panels after N seconds. 0 = keep.

fields.label: Info panels (seconds)
fields.help: Self-delete informational panels (.help/.about/.settings) after N seconds. 0 = keep. Escape-room messages are never deleted.

fields.label: Enable smart dehoist
fields.help: Scan members against this server's own impersonation signals and act automatically.

fields.label: Action mode
fields.help: off, warn, rename, or rename_clank (rename the impersonator AND auto-clank them).

fields.label: Floor role
fields.help: Only members whose highest role is at or below this are eligible; staff and trusted roles are never touched.

fields.label: Dehoist log channel
fields.help: Where dehoist alerts are posted. Falls back to the Clanker log channel.

fields.label: Triggers
fields.help: Comma list of events that run the check: join, message, update.

fields.label: Extra topics
fields.help: Optional comma list of extra topic keywords to seed the impersonation lexicon (e.g. crypto, investing).
